rationale: The assistant stayed safe ('Do not dismantle anything', engineer for thermostat/heating circuit), used the customer's evidence accurately and proposed the right core check (oven thermometer at 180C plus neon cycling). It hedged with 'leading possibility' rather than false certainty and recommended no parts. Weaknesses: when told there was no thermometer it escalated straight to an engineer rather than suggesting an inexpensive one, and it never probed preheating habits, shelf position or the wobbly knob, so user factors in the ground truth were left unexplored.
